release_notes.title: Notion bar, chatbox and status fixes
release_notes.summary: Fixes for the Notion bar, the blocked chatbox, command running and wrong Offline messages.
added: The hidden PlazCode tab can be dragged around the screen; it returns to its place when you show the bar again.
fixed: Notion: the PlazCode bar no longer gets stuck out of place when another page or side panel opens.
Notion: command cards attach to the code block, never to the reply's text.
Notion: custom agent chats are recognised.
The chatbox is no longer blocked for seconds after the AI finishes replying.
Only the real command block runs; examples in text, plaintext or inline code are ignored.
The app and bar no longer wrongly show Offline or Check unavailable while connected.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.

release_notes.title: Startup, sign-in and ChatGPT fixes
release_notes.summary: Fixes for ChatGPT, DeepSeek, startup and sign-in problems found since 1.24.30, plus a guest mode.
added: Guest mode: if a profile can't be created, "Use PlazCode as a guest" keeps your settings, skills and memory on this computer, separate from online profiles.
Safer file work: the AI can use paths inside your project and preview files read-only.
Memory notes are loaded only when they are relevant, and AI results use one standard shape.
Command batches use one call shape, and the AI is told which capabilities are granted.
improved: Windows startup errors now name the folder and the missing file, and the Mac check matches the real app layout.
Slow Blender scenes get more time, and long single-line edits are handled in safe pieces.
fixed: ChatGPT: startup no longer hangs on "Starting Up" or "Send paused", including in Work mode.
ChatGPT: typing freezes, false "sent" confirmations and lost tool results.
Leftover startup text no longer stays in the message box.
The screenshot pop-up no longer shows a black box.
DeepSeek: false startup warnings, stuck sends and broken line breaks.
Sign-up and log-in recover from busy or offline servers; saved logins stay usable.
Windows: false "program files changed" startup error, and Windows paths inside the project.
Blender: first-time setup on Windows.
Ox Alpha: Copy is no longer counted as a message sent.
The AI keeps working on your project after short follow-ups.
notes: Update the PlazCode app and the extension together (the app's updater does this).
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before; your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.

release_notes.title: Screenshots, approvals and update warnings
release_notes.summary: Improves screenshot display, remembers task approvals in Plan Mode, and makes mismatched app and extension versions clear.
improved: The desktop Updates page shows active browser extension versions. Known outdated versions stay red when a later check fails.
fixed: Screenshot previews render from image bytes instead of image URLs that AI sites can block. Unreadable image data shows an error.
Approve all for this task now applies to the same command in Plan Mode.
Creation previews explain missing app support, oversized requests and invalid responses instead of showing a JSON parsing error.
notes: Replacing only the EXE does not update an extension loaded from another folder. Use the full update and load the updated extension folder.
Real Studio captures and the reported creation-preview failure were not reproduced on the affected computer.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized.

release_notes.title: Fewer limit errors and lower usage
release_notes.summary: Fixes the "message exceeds your input limit" error that stopped Claude in the middle of normal work, and makes PlazCode use noticeably less of your AI plan.
improved: PlazCode uses less of your AI plan: the AI no longer has to look up each command before using it, Ultra mode no longer re-sends its whole skill pack with every request, and the extra reference PlazCode adds to a request is smaller.
When the AI saves a note to your vault, PlazCode no longer sends the whole vault summary straight back to it.
fixed: Claude (and other sites) stopped with "This message exceeds your 12000 character input limit" even after a normal prompt. The extra notes PlazCode adds now always fit your limit: they are shortened, or wait for the next message. Command results themselves are never cut.
notes: Your Input characters setting still works the same for everything you type.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized, as before. Your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
